$comment: Translation POLICY, not translation data. Consumed by the i18n guard tests. Keep flat catalogs (<lang>.json) free of metadata so any TMS can read them directly.

englishOnly.$comment: Deliberately English in every language: full sentences where a machine translation is worse than an honest English fallback. A native reviewer must do these by hand. Guard tests assert NO language block defines them.

reviewPending.$comment: Domains whose non-English strings are machine-drafted and still awaiting native review.

machineTranslated.$comment: Keys drafted by machine, pending native review.

domains.$comment: Key prefixes grouping the catalog into reviewable domains. Replaces the old one-part-file-per-domain layout: the guard tests slice the flat catalogs by these prefixes. A prefix list is also the natural unit to hand a translator.

englishOnlyDomains.$comment: Domains deliberately shipped English-only for now. bodyMap is the body heat map: the tab is English on every locale, tracked as known debt rather than machine-translated.
